q1_issues.issue: "in the city" is attached to the created earthquakes rather than to the causing event; the create/position rule puts Location on the event ONLY and explicitly forbids also locating the thing the event brought about.

"earthquakes" is an occurrence the verb brings into being, which the occurrence-object rule (a verb that changes whether/when an occurrence happens) sends to Patient; Theme rests only on the causative-complement bullet, so the two rules conflict on this object.

q2_gaps: locative universal "everywhere" (and "throughout" in its spatial sense) — Quantifiers ranges over kinds, groups and occurrences, and "throughout" is covered only as the temporal During, so a universal over locations has no form and is silently dropped
notes: "everywhere" is dropped entirely, weakening the claim to "caused earthquakes in the city". Reading the bare-plural object as a group witness is defensible but not the only licensed option (the non-specific bare class symbol is the other).
